card.statement:
Let a marked block matrix $M$ be
indecomposable. Then either

- [(a)] all blocks of $M$
are empty except for one
crossed block that is
nonsingular, or

- [(b)] $M$ is equivalent
to a matrix whose entries are
only 0's and 1's with at most
one 1 in each row and each
column.
card.label: Lemma 6

paper.title: Cycles of linear and semilinear mappings
paper.abstract: We give a canonical form of matrices of a cycle of linear or semilinear mapping V_1 --- V_2 --- ... --- V_t --- V_1 in which all V_i are complex vector spaces, each line is an arrow ---> or <---, and each arrow denotes a linear or semilinear mapping.
